[[File:MasAmeddaStaff-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] holding the Speaker's staff]]
In the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the '''Speaker's staff''' was a long wooden [[Scepter/Legends|scepter]] wielded by the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the Senate, who was often referred to as the ''Speaker'', to demonstrate his authority over the Senate's debates. It had crisscrossing carved lines running down its length, and it was capped by a dull golden figure of the ancient demagogue [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]], one of the controversial [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]].

During the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and the transformation of the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the staff was held by the current Vice Chair, [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]]. The staff's fate after [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] is unknown.

A different speaker's staff was used during [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan]] in [[43 ABY]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was gnarled staff with skull on the top.
